name: Kippy
review: We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb had everything we could have asked for, with great amenities, we especially loved the pool and hot tub. The kitchen was fully stocked with everything we needed, which made our stay so easy and comfortable. The views were absolutely amazing, and the space was beautiful and relaxing. Debra was very welcoming and easy to communicate with. We would definitely stay here again!

name: Jacob
review: Second time staying there and I will definitely be back. Beautiful spot in west Kelowna.

name: Shaylynn
review: Incredible stay!! In a very quiet and peaceful neighborhood, the pool and hot tub were perfect for a hang out spot, so much room in the place for sleeping and hanging out and very easy access and close to wineries and local shops/restaurants. Will for sure stay here again when we return!

name: Gurpreet Singh
review: Its very nice place with amazing view and hot tub and private pool. Highly recommended

name: Carolane
review: Amazing experience with the best view and location! Debra was very communicative and helpful when we needed anything even had amazing recommendations for restaurants! Overall enjoyed and will be back!

name: Brittany Gillian
review: The backyard area was very nice and great for the kids and adults and was really nice to go back and relax at after a day at the beach. The big thing is there is a lot of rules and so we were walking on egg shells the whole trip. Rules on not being able to use the pool or hot tub after 10pm and only being allowed to have music on low for the entire day at a level that couldn’t be heard upstairs or by the neighbours definitely killed the vibe a bit. There were limited towels provided for the pool and shower even though it is advertised for up to 8 people, and limited kitchen clothes provided so I would recommend bringing your own. The bathroom was also quite ran down. Debra was quite responsive to any questions that we had during the stay.

name: Fabiola
review: We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described, comfortable, and in a great location. We really enjoyed our weekend in Kelowna, and the accommodation made our trip even better. The host was responsive, and made the check-in process easy. Thank you!!

name: Katelyn
review: We took our family of 4 (two kiddos ages 2.5 and 11 months) and my parents. we had a blast. The place is beautiful. My littles had a blast in the pool. Debra was amazing to communicate with, always answered very quickly with any questions we had. This stay couldn’t have been more perfect. Highly recommend!

name: Zahran
review: Overall the place is great positioned in a nice neighborhood with great views. Pool and hot tub made it entertaining and fun, however there is a cut off at 10 and you are warned to not make noise after 10 as she lives upstairs and neighbours are stingy. Made the experience feel a little constricted and constant thought of noise. She is conflicting at times with her words with stayijg a little later in the hot tub but overall nice. If youre calm youll like this.

name: Heidi Suzzane
review: Was short but lovely stay, the Pool and hot tub were amazing along with the view and privacy. I would book again, the beds were comfortable and lots of space for our party. Thank you Debra for the great hospitality ❤️

name: Esther Barbara
review: Very clean, great pool and spa. Easy to find. Spacious. Big kitchen. No washing machine. Comfortable beds. Short drive to shops.

name: Yaroslava
review: Everything's great

name: Aleena
review: Great place to stay in Kelowna! The pool and hot tub were nice. Kitchen has appliances not an actual stove, but that wasn’t a problem for us.

name: Heather
review: Great location.  Beautiful views. Would stay again.

name: Tyra
review:
The view was amazing! Hot tub and pool were a great addition, kitchen had what we needed to cook. Check in was easy and quick. 
Although, host definitely could have addressed a miscommunication better, instead of what I felt as an attack, which left my group and I feeling the need to walk on egg shells the rest of the weekend. Upon reading other reviews, it would appear that any partial negative review is twisted around on the guest. Before booking, we asked for permission to have some drinks around the pool and it was allowed.  We had hung a banner for photos (not knowing it wasn’t allowed) and host had came down into our space without warning, twice, after we were told the space would be ours. Host was mad it was never disclosed it was for an event, although there was no partying. We feel there was not the level of privacy that was advertised. You can hear them walking around early mornings, with a pet as well which was not disclosed and a friend suffered allergy symptoms all weekend

name: Dave
review: Everything was as described. The unit had lots of space. Pool & Hot Tub were great. Debra was easy to communicate with and welcoming for our stay.

name: Sherrene
review: We had a fantastic stay at Debra's place! Sparkling clean, very spacious suite with all the amenities you could need. Beds and linens were so comfortable. Debra was very friendly and communicative. Extremely quiet neighbourhood with amazing view. Being able to relax in the hot tub in the evening was such a nice bonus. Would definitely stay again!

name: Craig
review: Fantastic

name: Kin Fung
review: Good host

name: Kara-Lee
review:
The location and amenities made up for the host being very strict on rules. 
We were a small six-girl bachelorette party celebrating our bride-to-be! We were not rowdy or over the top, keeping quiet while in the house playing board games. While we definitely had a good time and really enjoyed the pool and water slide during the day, but the host was very strict on her rules. Upon arrival, a large rules book was waiting for us. We got complaints about noise, though we were a small group that wouldn’t have been louder than any other group heading up there. We also got complaints about street parking, saying we were parked in a neighbours “air bnb spot” (when the entire street was empty and regular street parking). 
Overall a nice unit to stay in though, and again the pool and outdoor space was very nice with a beautiful view!

name: Brianne
review:
We enjoyed our stay at Debra’s place. The suite was very clean, and the amenities were a highlight—we loved being able to use the pool, sauna, and hot tub. Debra was also very accommodating with our request for an early check-in, which we appreciated.
There were a couple of small things that could be improved. The outdoor garbage hadn’t been taken care of before our arrival, which caused an unpleasant smell on the patio. We also experienced some miscommunication during our stay. Upon arrival, we were questioned about our check-in time and not very warmly greeted by the upstairs owner, who was working on the pool, which made it unavailable even though we had arranged early access. At checkout, we were asked about damage we did not cause, and when we requested details or photos, none were provided. We were later told all was fine, but it caused unnecessary stress.
Overall, we had a lovely stay and enjoyed the space and amenities. With a few adjustments, it would be even better.

name: Kim
review: Gorgeous views from the outside and in!  Even though it was a coolish September, I was able to get a swim in daily, and then enjoy the warmth of the hottub. The sauna was an added bonus that was well enjoyed!  Debra and Mike were very responsive and timely for any requests made, even rearranging a personal appointment when our check-in time changed that day. Good towels for both bath and pool. Bedroom beds were quite comfortable. As noted, this is not a party house, one of R&R.  Do realize that the owners live above, and as this was built as a house you will hear the occasional noise/steps from upstairs. TV had most anything you'd like to watch. All in all, great amenities!

name: Emma
review:
We really loved staying at Debra's place, the view is fabulous. 
The pool, slide and and hot tub are a great addition and one of the reasons we chose this accommodation. 
There is some noise from a road below but we do not hear it when we are inside and we found that we weren't bothered by it at all.
The home is very clean and spacious and we would certainly like to return. 
We found that the space was very private, however when we needed to get in touch with Debra (for a small request), she was available immediately. 
Great place to stay, we would definitely recommended.

name: Melissa
review:
Absolutely loved staying at Debra’s poolside getaway. The place was clean, organized, and perfectly set up to enjoy a relaxing vacation. 
The pool and hot tub we found were surprisingly private, there was even a water slide!  Only side note I would mention is that the backyard/pool area is not enclosed. There is a large drop off with no fence, just some bushes. Although our little one just stayed close to our side, so it didn’t effect us much. But might if you had a 2-5 year old who liked to run around, or had difficulties listening to boundaries. 
All in all, we would 100% stay again!

name: Sarah
review: I came to Debra's place with my 4 girlfriends, we were looking for a beautiful place to relax and have fun and we found just that! We had to delay check-in multiple times due to traffic and Debra was very accommodating. The neighbourhood is nice and quiet, the views from the pool deck are even better than the photos. Even though the owners live upstairs, it is as though you have the place to yourself. The hosts were quiet and pretty much out of sight, unless something was needed. We had a great trip - enjoyed the pool (the slide is a must!), were a quick drive to the beach, wineries and downtown Kelowna. Debra was an excellent host and we would love to come back and stay here again!

name: Vickie
review:
Great location. Awesome view. 



Had a very swift and easy check-in. Was enjoying the pool and waterslide right away. 



Debra was very accessible and quick to respond to messages, but also left us alone to do our own thing, which was nice.



Kitchen is well stocked. Lots of space to comfortably sleep 8. Would stay again.

name: Hunter
review: The place was great and spacious. The view was beautiful and relaxing. The hot tub was great. Debra was quick to respond to my messages. Kitchen had everything we needed. If I was being picky I would note that you can definitely hear foot steps upstairs if you're a light sleeper, but it wasn't as noticeable in the main living area where the two beds are located. Overall we had a great time and really enjoyed our stay.

name: Sarah
review: Spent the weekend at Debra's place with my 2 sisters.  It was a spacious suite that really would sleep 8 comfortably. There is only 1 washroom though so I would fare warning if you do have a large group as even with just 3 women, we did have to plan accordingly and use other spaces to get ready. However, 2 large bedrooms plus 2 large common room type space gives you lots of roomy options to do so.  The pool, hot tub and views were beautiful. Although Debra and her family were home, we felt like we had the house to ourselves and never felt like people were watching us or in the space.  If you are a light sleeper, then you can hear people above you but nothing above normal then a typical ground level suite.  5 minute drive to all the West Kelowna wineries and you can clearly see Mission Hills from the home.  Looking forward to staying here again in the future.

name: Eric
review:
Our host was gracious, informative and inconspicuous. 



An example of their kindness: We were going to arrive an hour earlier than the agreed upon time and she didn't hesitate to make these arrangements for us. 



The space suited our needs, the kitchen was plain, but functional. The beds were comfortable and everything was clean.



The hot tub, pool and view were amazing.



We would certainly stay here again in the future.

name: Sue
review:
We were 4 retired ladies looking for a girls get away weekend.  It was perfect....comfy beds, crisp linens, lots of towels for the hot tub,  sauna and shower.  The weather was a tad cool for the pool...but we loved sitting on the patio for our morning coffee and in the afternoon with our freshly bought wines!  The location is awesome for wine touring.  I'm planning to be back and will also recommend this place to my grown children and grankids.  They would love it.  
I communicated with Debra and she always responded quickly.  We were missing a couple of items...Kleenex and tin foil...and Debra popped them down within minutes.
All in all....the 4 of us had a great, relaxing time and would recommend this air bnb for families and small groups of friends.  I am so happy we found and tried this place.

name: Kathleen
review: This was a very comfortable stay.  Kitchen was well equipped, bed in bedroom was comfortable, infrared sauna was nice as right in unit.  Hot tub out the door of unit.  Very private and quiet.  Lots of towels.  Everything was perfect.  Debra even had a heater for me in the unit as I had mentioned that I was concerned that the unit be warm.  Lots of room in the unit to accommodate more people.  It was only me staying so I really enjoyed the amenities.

name: Elliot
review: Our stay at Debra’s house was great. The setup is perfect for families or larger groups and especially nice to have full use of the backyard with pool, hot tub, comfy furniture and BBQ. The interior is spacious and well laid out with enough space for everyone. We didn’t get a chance to enjoy the sauna but would for sure on another trip. It is easy to find and the location is pretty good, being just about 10 minutes from the bridge to downtown depending on traffic. There are many amenities nearby. Communication with Debra was easy and she responded quick to all our questions. Would definitely stay again.

name: Barb
review: Debra communicated well beforehand, met us and showed us how to use everything and was friendly. The accommodations were very spacious and comfortable. Nice bedding and comfy bed. The best part was the backyard with the pool and hot tub with a great view of the valley. Great for a quiet stay or for families.

name: Scott
review:
Great views, pool and hot tub were clean and fun. The place was as great as the pictures made it out to be.
The host met us to go through the place and show us what we needed to know and after that left us to enjoy our stay. She was also quick to respond to questions and concerns which is nice. 
You can hear foot traffic as it is a basement, it didn't really bother us but it's probably something light sleepers would like to know.

name: Bell
review: The home had a beautiful view and the kitchen was very well stocked. We also appreciated the welcoming greeting upon arrival. That said, we found that the indoor space didn’t have enough seating for our group, so we had to spend more time outside. Since the hosts were often outside as well and mentioned they had early mornings, we tried to keep noise to a minimum, which made it a bit challenging to fully relax. There were quite a few house rules, and overall it felt like we weren’t able to make full use of the space.

name: Mike
review: Another amazing stay in Debra's lovely home! This place has so many amenities for everyone to enjoy. From the obvious pool, hot tub and water slide to the indoor sauna and gorgeous patio to enjoy the view of the lake, a BBQ feast or an evening drink under the well placed mood lighting. Whether a family getaway or a trip for you and someone special, you will not be disappointed with your stay. Everything about our time here was easy going from the get go. Debra is a great host and I appreciate her ensuring that we had everything we needed. No hesitation that I'll be back here again. Thanks for the memories!

name: Grant
review: We enjoyed our 2 nights at Debra's house. We also thought we were renting the entire house, however the basement suite was very large. The beds were very comfortable and we loved the the pool and hot tub. The water slide was great fun even for a 62 yr old kid. The kitchen could use more lighting and more dish towels. Our feeling is that not all guests wash dishes thoroughly and I found a bowl in the cupboard that wasn't clean and a couple of utensils too. We would suggest that Airbnb policy should mandate dishwashers for all rentals. We also found the stairs uneven and steep and  the noise level was bad during our visit. Wouldn't want to live with all the highway and construction noise. Not a bad deal for a rental but probably wouldn't stay here again.

name: Stephanie
review: Everything about Debra's place is great. The location is perfect, about 10 mins from downtown Kelowna, in a quiet residential neighborhood. Debra is very quick with responding to messages. We were a group of 8 girls, and there were enough space for all of us.  The pool and view is amazing, such a great feature to have for those hot summer days! Would definitely stay here again.

name: Kevin
review: My cousins and I had a great time staying at the Lakeview Suite in West Kelowna. Debra and Mike were great hosts, and the suite was very private. The view is amazing and the pool/waterslide/hot tub/sauna combo was excellent. The Natural Gas BBQ cooked the chicken we brought very nicely as well. The kitchen area was a good size, the lighting was a little dim but all in all, it worked out well.

name: Chrislyne
review: Great place to stay, beds were comfortable. Too bad we were not able to use the amenities that we think we paid for because of our tight schedule. Also, we woke up at 4:30 am because of the fire alarm - batteries went out and was alarming non stop and need to wake up in the middle of our sleep to turn it off. No body wash in washroom as well. But, All in all place is nice!

name: Rachel-Clark
review:
Overall, I would not choose to stay again.
What was great : The location and view were great, and there was a lot of nice shared space and outdoor space for families.
Not so good: The cleanliness - there was too much dust, both inside and on outdoor furniture, and the bathroom was not in the best condition. Additionally, the utensils and kitchen equipment were outdated, and the condiments were very poor and out of date. I also prefer more flexibility with check-in times and more privacy.

name: Ashley
review:
This is a great location, pool and hot tub are amazing! It was clean and the beds were comfortable. The host greeted us, explained the rules and showed us how to use the hot tub. We were aware of the rules to reduce the noise by 10pm. We were there to have a great time - just 5 gals. 
We requested to communicate any issues via text only, which we felt was very reasonable - we expected privacy.
What surprised us is the host continuously came downstairs into the space, and told us her family would be using the pool while we were gone at the beach. We voiced that made us feel uncomfortable & we felt it was inappropriate. If we rent out a space that states private pool and hot tub, we expect that is to be used by us only. We were also woken up at 430am by loud stomping above every morning. 
This property is great for small families & senior citizens. Based on what we've read in other reviews, we fully expect a reply with something we've done wrong and placing blame on us for everything.

name: Lisa
review: Our stay was so relaxing! Debra's place was very clean, close to lots of shopping and restaurants, very quick responses, amazing hot tub with a gorgeous view!!! The pictures of the space don't do it justice. There's TONS of space! Thank you Debra and Mike for a very restful and beautiful stay for two tired Mom's in need of a night away!

name: Christa
review: We are a family of 5, and this place was perfect! There was plenty of room, kitchen is FULLY equipped. The kids loved the pool and hot tub. The view is gorgeous and the hosts were great to deal with! No complaints at all, had a great stay!

name: Nadia
review: You might want to read this. We stayed at Debra’s house for two nights. The location and views are nice and it is close by to a lot of things. However... Few things that we weren’t happy with. Firstly the door/entrance to the house did not lock or curtains and when I brought it to her attention she mentioned that it is not a worry. Except it is a safety issue for many reasons. Secondly since we had booked the place at a cold season there was no heating system. Only two small electric heaters which is not enough to heat up the space properly for the size of her place. There was a fireplace too but every time i turned it on it would shut off after few mins as well it would cut off the electricity for the tv and the lights in the bathroom. Thirdly, her “kitchen” i assume used to be a bedroom. There is no vent above her gas/fire stove which is yet another safety issue. In her rules she states that everything has to be clean but when we looked at her cutlery and dishes almost everything was dirty and not properly washed. We also found bugs and stains in her cutlery drawers which suggests it has not been cleaned prior to our arrival, but she has so many rules on cleanliness? The towels that were provided looked like they were from the stone ages, discoloured and dirty looking. We bought our own towels and paper plates and cups etc because we did not want to use anything there. Another thing to mention is that she was constantly watching everything we do. We felt uncomfortable and unwelcome at all times. In conclusion it is not worth the view and your money.

name: Aaron
review:
The place had a great pool, hot tub, and patio setup. These were very enjoyable. Also, prior to our stay, owners were very quick to respond to all questions and inquiries. Inside, accommodations were adequate but carpet had some stains, the furniture is quite dated, the kitchen area is rather dark and the dishes in the cupboards weren't all clean. 
The bathroom was very small. 
We also had to contact owners the first night because the air bed was leaking. They seemed bothered by the request and then insinuated that we broke it. I asked for a suggested compensation in the total rental cost as it wasn't fixed the second night either. No compensation was given. 
In the end, for the price, I would suggest pursuing a different rental in the area.

name: Jenn
review:
Absolutely loved our stay here! The neighbourhood was nice and quiet and still close to everything.
The space was nice and spacious and had everything we needed. The pool and hot tub was an incredible bonus! We would definitely stay here again!

name: Jessie
review: Debra was friendly and responsive.  We showed up last minute and she was very accommodating, even tapped the NHL game for us while we used the pool so we wouldn't miss anything. They do live above as clearly stated in the description but I felt they gave us our own space. Bed was super comfy and made for a restful sleep before catching a flight the next day.

name: Sandy
review: The space was great! Had definitely been updated since the pictures too! It is a walkout basement so can hear the people living upstairs sometimes but was usually not too loud! Very clean and styled well! We really enjoyed the outdoor amenities and Debra was always available to help whenever we needed anything extra! Great host and a great stay!

name: Christine
review: Debra's place is perfect for families. It's clean, has plenty of space, and great amenities. Our son loved the pool, waterslide, and hot tub - there were even water games and pool noodles available. There's also a sauna, thought we didn't use it during our stay. There are 2 bedrooms each with a queen bed, plus 2 queen beds in the open area beside the dining room. Kitchen was large and well equipped.

name: Emma
review: This was an excellent Airbnb experience in beautiful West Kelowna. We were a group of 7 and the house was perfect for us - lots of room, comfortable sleeping arrangements and a beautiful pool/deck area with stunning views of the lake. Location was great for accessibility to wineries and all of the scenery the Okanagan has to offer. Little bit of a trek to downtown Kelowna - $30 cab ride each way. Debra and her husband were great hosts - checked in with me regularly to make sure we had everything we needed but also left us to our own devices. It felt like we had the entire place to ourselves even though they live above. Would definitely recommend this place to groups who are looking for a fun Okanagan getaway.

name: Jasmine
review: Debra’s place was beautiful and I would definitely recommend the home. If you are a noisy group she will give you warnings as she is strict about noise (we were a group of 6 girls so it was hard to keep it down after 10pm). Sometimes it felt like big brother because it’s like you are being watched all the time since the host lives upstairs. Overall a cool place, great location and well kept (both inside and outside).

name: Justin
review:
Good stay for a good price. 
I wouldn’t considering this a luxury suite but it gets the job done especially if you plan on spending most of your time outside. The beds in the common space are a little hard and they squeak but would be fine for kids (but FYI they are in the dining space). The suite is large and the pool/view/outdoor lounge space is wonderful! The owners were kind and offered us complete privacy! 
The kitchen is dark and closed off so if you plan to do a lot of cooking I would recommend to do your prep work before hand and plan bbq meals. Overall things were clean but the kitchen appliances and bbq could use a deep clean. 
Overall would recommend to a small group who’s not wanting to spend too much and wants to spend lots of time in the pool!
Thanks Debra!

name: Thomas
review: This is such a terrific space!  There is ample room to relax and unwind inside and out.  The pool, hot tub, and sauna are really amazing amenities, and having private access to them all was really awesome.  The view from the backyard is really special as well.   We really had a fantastic family trip and our home base was a key reason why we could really unwind and relax.

name: Kari
review:
This property was beautiful with a beautiful. Hot tub and pool were awesome. 
Debra was away available and checked in often to see how we were doing. 
This home was kept very clean and had everything you need for a comfortable stay. 
Would definitely recommend this property.

name: Katt
review:
I read reviews before going and some of the not so good reviews about Debra’s place were totally WRONG! 
Debra has a beautiful home and we had an amazing stay. She was attentive and very understanding of our very late (11pm) check-in due to traffic delays we experienced on our trip. 
We had an amazing experience. We went to Kelowna for my son’s tournament and thought this would be the cherry on top of a special trip, and it definitely was! 
We felt right at home there. We experienced great privacy due to the location but also from the hosts. Debra was also quick to help us with anything we needed while we were there. 
Beautiful home, amazing outside area, great location, awesome host. 
The kids and us were all amazed by how comfy the beds and pillows were! We slept like babies! 
In the end I have nothing but amazing things to say about our host, stay, and their beautiful home they shared with us. We absolutely loved it and we can’t wait to come again in the summer! 
Thank you!

name: Delaney
review: Deb’s place was great. The view from the pool area is unbeatable. The beds were comfortable and the living area was very clean. Check in was a breeze and overall communication was very good. Our group spent a lot of time in downtown Kelowna and at wineries but it was awesome to come back to a peaceful environment and also enjoy a pool day!

name: Andrew
review: We had an amazing stay! The house was very spacious and extremely clean everything felt fresh and well taken care of. The new hot tub was a huge highlight and made the stay even better. The host was incredibly helpful, super nice, and easy to communicate with the entire time.

name: Rick
review:
Everything was as advertised. Great location for us as it was close to my Dad in West Kelowna.
Only issue was sound proofing as we could hear walking around above us. Otherwise fabulous place.

name: Kelley
review:
The property had a stunning view and the children loved the pool. Host was very responsive and really enjoyed the peacefulness and surrounding nature. 
This was the first time staying at an Air BnB where people are living on the property and the only drawback was not knowing the “ house rules” in advance and not being able to control the thermostat. 
Lovely area and felt safe and great attractions close by like Griffin farms, Kangaroo Creek Farm, many winery’s, highly recommend Derrick’s Steakhouse, Pulp Fiction Coffee House, and very close a recommended masseuse by the host that was very affordable and amazing service. Definitely recommend for a relaxing and calm stay to recharge your batteries.

name: Susan
review: Our family of four had a fantastic time at Debra’s house.  The pool and waterslide were so much fun and the suite itself is clean, huge and completely above ground (apart from the kitchen).   Debra and Mike were friendly and helpful but also very respectful of our space and vacation time.  We’d definitely stay here again.

name: Jess
review: The place was clean and in a great location and the outside space was amazing!  The layout was a little weird with two of the beds being in the dining room. we felt that it was under stocked, we had to ask for more toilet paper, garbage bags, dishwasher pucks over the course of our 4 day stay, There was no coffee in the kitchen. There was a full binder of rules we received when we checked in ( lots that where not listed on the air bnb site) having to communicate with the owners about the above listed we found it wasn't as relaxing as it could have been. It felt that we where being watched to make sure none of the rules where being broken. We where not a rowdy bunch it was a family vacation and we just wanted to relax and enjoy each others company.

name: Sandra
review: The location of this suite and the view are outstanding.  We weren't lucky to have warm enough weather to enjoy the pool, but that made the hot tub even more of a bonus. The care that was taken to keep the hot tub running was and clean was truly appreciated.  The kitchen was really well stocked and the sheets & towels were fantastic and plentiful. There were lots of pamphlets and brochures to help us make our plans and there was so much to see and do really close by.  Debra was a lovely host - responsive yet not intrusive.

name: Jenn
review:
Our family had such a wonderful stay at Debra’s place! The apartment was very spacious, tons of room for all, great linens, full stocked kitchen, big tv, private entrance not to mention amazing pool and hot tub space. Our family of five including two teenagers had an absolute blast. Debra was even so kind bringing out pool toys for the kids. Great central
Location close to everything you need. Wonderful host. Highly recommend!

name: Jessica
review: We had a wonderful time here at Debra’s guest suite it was clean and organized well. She greeted us at the door and walked us through she was lovely. We enjoyed the hot tub and pool. The views were incredible you can’t ask for a better location. It is clearly stated it is not a party house but perfect for relaxation. As long as you treat the property like your own and respect it you will have a wonder time here. Definitely will be back this summer with my partner !! Thanks again Debra!

name: Carla
review: Staying at this Airbnb was an absolute delight! Debra was warm and welcoming and was quick to respond if I had any questions.  The space was impeccably clean, beautifully decorated, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect, allowing us to easily explore the surrounding area whether it was Kelowna or West Kelowna with easy access to the highway.  We were able to enjoy a peaceful retreat at the end of the day that still felt secluded. I would highly recommend this Airbnb high.

name: Hannah
review: This please is fantastic, the views from the jacuzzi are beautiful! We stayed for Christmas so had stunning views of the snowy mountains. The suite is super comfy and the added surprise of the indoor sauna was a real treat. The kitchen is so well stocked, perfect for groups cooking at home. Overall a great stay and Debra could not have been more helpful and quick to respond, thank you for a wonderful stay Debra!

name: Brenda
review: This place was amazing, the view, the pool, the suite, pretty much everything was great!!! The host, Debra, met me when I arrived, showed me around, told me how everything works. always answered my messages very quickly. The kitchen was very well stocked, the bed was sooooo comfortable! Everything was great! I will definitely book again and would highly recommend this suite.

name: Ben
review:
Pros:
-Pool and hot tub were clean and a blast to use. The water slide was great and the views were really spectacular. 
-There was plenty of space for 3 adults and two little kids. 
-Nice, quiet, removed location was perfect to get away from downtown. 
-Never felt like Debra and her family were in our space at all. 
Cons:
Beds were not all comfortable and bedding/pillows could be a lot better quality.
-Some cleanliness issues with the kitchen drawers and utensils.
- The walls throughout were not overly clean. Some incomplete construction areas on the walls as well-nothing major but it took away from our experience. 
-The patio furniture was quite dated. 
Overall we did have a good stay. The space checked off all the boxes, but just could've been better.

name: Shauna
review: Debras place was amazing! The pool and hot tub were great bonuses. The Airbnb is super spacious and the beds were comfy! It’s in a great location - close to everything. Debra was quick to respond and super welcoming when we arrived. It is a share place, but you would never know it was.  I would definitely recommend this place for a relaxing vacation.

name: Tina
review: Debra's place was the perfect location for a reunion of friends with perfect weather and a killer view. The hot tub and pool are wonderful amenities to this well located property. The five of us singles slept comfortably but harder to have more if guests are not couples as beds need to be shared. New kitchen and working appliances like ice maker in fridge and dishwasher a big help for larger groups. Attentive host, accommodating and friendly.

name: Tyrza
review: Debra’s home was exactly like the photos and description. We loved the privacy and the views we had. The location is amazing for being close to stores we needed (Walmart, dollarama). Even with them living above we weren’t woken up to any noise, and it was quiet throughout the day, we didn’t see them much at all either. Great place to stay and affordable!

name: Parinaz
review: Debra’s place was very clean and exactly like the pictures. All the amenities we needed were provided, and the neighborhood was peaceful and quiet. Just a small note: if you enjoy listening to music, make sure to keep the volume very low since they are quite sensitive . Overall, we had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed our time here.

name: Mark
review:
An absolutely beautiful home!  Debra was awesome!  Very friendly and easy to communicate with to get checked in.  Once we arrived the place was set up perfectly and fit 4 of us with LOTS of room to spare.  The yard is everything you think it will be and more.  Pool, patio, hot tub ... And What a view!

Debra you will definitely be getting another request the next time we come out your way. Thank you for sharing your home it really added a great night to our trip!

name: Maddy
review:
Debra’s place had a lovely view. It is best suited for a group of adults or adults with older children to stay. 
Pros-
-large enough bedrooms to fit a portable crib or pack and play at the end of the bed 
-nice, spacious hot tub 
-nice linens 
Cons-
-we came across dirty silverware and dishes, which was off putting, especially when considering that there is a high cleaning fee for this space
-along with the high cleaning fee came a large list of check out cleaning/to do list that we had to do before leaving  
-we would have preferred curtains on the main door for more privacy 
-quite cold, especially if you have an infant 
-not enough bowls for more than two or three people 
-no washer/dryer (it is as advertised but I didn’t consider that we’d prefer to wash our swimsuits asap rather than packing them while dirty)
Overall, this space worked okay for our needs, but I’d recommend it to a group of adults or a family with older children.

name: Tiara
review: I’m not sure why people have written negative reviews about this place. We stayed for a few days, and it was nothing but awesome. Debra walked us through a couple things when we arrived, and made us feel right at home. We have nothing but positive things to say about this place. I’ll be back for sure!

name: Katrina
review: Debra was nice and communicative. The outdoor amenities were amazing, and the views-spectacular! Some little extras would have been nice for the price, like coffee grounds etc! Other than that, the place was clean and cozy! Perfect for a weekend getaway with the family! Would stay here again!

name: Joyce
review: Stayed for 2 nights. Nice house, great hot tub with the view! It would be better if the hot tub could be warmer. Also, a bit cold with the thin duvets and no access for the central heat although we appreciate that Debra already turned up the heat for us. Good communication!

name: Julie
review: Attentive, accommodating and non-intrusive hosts. The suite is quite spacious and Debra has loads of pamphlets on the area. The queen bed and pillows that we used were super comfy. Views from the hot tub were breathtaking! It didn't even matter that it rained because the hot tub is in a covered area from which you can soak in the beauty of the Okanagan lake view. We also enjoyed the scented candles while we snuggled up by the electric fireplace and watched some Netflix. Our home away from home had everything we needed for a perfect little romantic getaway. Thanks for everything Debra!

name: Ehsan
review: This place is super nice with a great view and nice pool, sauna and hot tub. The host was friendly and helpful. If you like BBQ'ing while at the pool/hot tub give T-bones a try; they have a large selection of marinated meat which won't disappoint! Our host recommended that and we definitely enjoyed everything during our one-night stay including the BBQ! The only complain would be that the weather wasn't super nice which obviously is out of the host's or anybody else's control! We will be back at this place next summer!!

name: Ciara
review: Excellent stay at Debra’s. Absolutely stunning scenery right from the pool and hot tub. Stores are 10 min drive away, was able to have BBQ. Bath and beach towels provided. Organised our wine tour with Brandy which was incredible value for money. Would highly recommend!

name: Deveney
review: This property was in a beautiful location. Debra was very communicative with me around check-in and made herself available to come down and go over the place. The property is extremely clean but welcoming. Debra has put in a lot of thought and effort on the small details such as the toilet roll being stamped and the towel placement in each bed. The layout provides lots of room for all to enjoy. The outdoor area was beautiful, the pool is well maintained and they have a great water slide + hot tub. Not enough great things to say about this property. We will be back! Highly recommend:)

name: Drew
review: Nice location & hot tub. Hosts weren’t too friendly and quite a bit of rules. Overall place was clean & as advertised.

name: Diane
review:
The view- amazing! It's a basement suite but it doesn't feel like it as the space has plenty of natural light (except the kitchen but we didn't really use it) with lots of big windows. The hot tub and pool were awesome. 
Deborah was a fantastic host, she was helpful and available. She adds some nice touches like chocolates on the pillows and nice big bottles of shampoo and conditioner in the bathroom. Deborah provided a welcome package that included the rules, which looked like a long list of rules at first but they're pretty common sense so we didn't have any problems adhering to them. 
The layout is a little different but it worked for our needs- the air mattress and pull out couch are in a large common area that the kitchen and bathroom are off. The view from this area is incredible. 
I think it has been mentioned but the wifi isn't the greatest. If you have a good data plan, the cell service is fine.

name: Adam
review: Debra was awesome and the communication was great, we changed our check in time 3 times with no problems and she was always a phone call away for any questions.   4 of us slept very well and enjoyed the amazing outdoor space, the pool and hot tub were worth the stay alone.  We all would come back anytime.  Enjoy your stay as this host is great.

name: Christine
review:
The view is really amazing, there is a lot of space so it doesn't feel crowded.  They layout is slightly odd, but not a huge deal. 

Debra was very helpful when we forgot our muffin tin to make breakfast, as she let us borrow one.  The basement suite sleeps 8, with the 2 bedrooms, 1 pullout couch and an inflatable mattress 



Downsides 

- Stairs into the backyard are very steep and awkward, hopefully they plan on getting this fixed (If you are older or have any mobility issues, I would avoid this place for that reason)

- No dishwasher currently (though there is mention of them getting one in the fall)

- Wifi connection isn't great, very spotty in the basement.  If you need to work, its probably best to tether off your phone

- Highway is quite close, so you could always hear cars (this didnt bother us at all, but it might to some people) 

- Only 1 bathroom (with just a sliding door) this was an inconvenience at times, especially if you have a large group.  We also ran out of TP on the last day, not enough was provided initially and there wasn't any extra in the boiler room where the cleaning supplies were housed. 

- Host is very strict on rules and provided additional rules more than what was advertised a week before we arrived.  (She was also mad that we had an extra person at the place for 2 hours, even though I had it approved with her before I booked the place).

name: Karol
review:
Absolutely had a great time at Deb's house. All 7 of us slept comfortably, and there was more than enough space. Awesome location, the hot tub kept us warm into the night, and the waterslide was fun.



Debra was an amazing host, the right mix of being available and out of the way. If there was we needed she was more than happy to help. One night she even came down to hand us blankets to make sure we were warm enough on the patio. Would definitely book again.

name: Nathan
review:
Place was great. My only small complaint was that the Pool was quite chilly, despite the mid30s weather. Kids used the pool and waterslide a ton and then used the hot tub to warm up. 
Debra is very friendly and very prompt with responding to any issues we had. 
I’d stay again.

name: Joey
review: We enjoyed the Lakeview Suite. It was very spacious and comfortable for our group of 3 adults, 1 child and 1 baby. The hot tub was very welcome with the unusually chilly summer weather we experienced! There is some road noise, it's not terrible, but something to consider if you're sensitive to that.

name: Donna
review: The home was fantastic!  There was a bout 1300 square feet of space with 2 bedrooms, a kitchen, living room with big screen tv (telus optik tv and netflix included).   Each bedroom had a comfy queen size bed.  In addition to the bedrooms was another common area space that had another 2 queen size beds.  There was also a dining area, use of the hot tub and amazing views of the Okanogan Valley.  Grocery store and other amenities were an easy 10 minute drive away.  During the warmer months there is also an awesome pool to use.

name: Amanda
review: We had a very small get together for my husbands 30th birthday here! It’s early October so it was a bit cold, but the hot tub was so nice to relax in. The place was very clean and definitely met our expectations. The only thing that I would give a heads up about is that the sound-proofing is not great. I’m not sure if there’s another suite on the other side of the basement or a family room but we could definitely hear other people pretty well, which made me feel like they could probably hear us also. Not a huge deal but something to be aware of. Over all a really great stay and we would like to come back in the summer some time! The views are absolutely beautiful.

name: Stephen
review: Debra is a fantastic host , she made sure our stay was comfortable. The pool and hot tube were awesome , the house was clean. The neighbourhood is safe and the views were gorgeous. Debra was always making she we had enough towels for the pool and her family was very quite and respectful of our privacy. Highly Recommend staying with this family and I will stay again.

name: Alexandra
review:
Great mini vacation. First time using air bnb and it did not disappoint. Just what we needed. 
The suite was much bigger then I expected!! Excellent with respecting the Covid policies.  Overall highly recommend this place.
I sent the link to over ten of my friends after sharing pictures on social media everyone was asking where this oasis was. Huge hit for the kids definitely will be coming back once the pool is opened. The owner was quick with her responses and very helpful when needed. It also had amazing views 24/7.

name: Kent
review: A large and beautiful suite with a lovely backyard and amazing views of the lake and city! We really enjoyed the hot tub, sauna, and the gas fire bowl is great. The pool and slide were beautiful but very cold as we visited in November.

name: Rebekah
review: My family and I loved our stay here. Very clean and great location. The pool and barbecue area were also a big hit. Debra also organized a wine tour with Brandy, which was amazing! Really well organized and great communication before and throughout our stay. Would really recommend staying here.

name: Joey
review: Awesome place with an amazing view!! Has a pool, hot tub and a infrared sauna!! Quite location perfect for families. Clean and tidy. This is our second time here and would love to come back.

name: James
review: Overall good location with a really nice pool and amenities. Host was a bit difficult to communicate with as she replied to texts a lot later and not right away. Bbq was also super disgustingly unclean. Other than that, good experience!

name: Jarome
review: Debra was very responsive and accommodating to us. Her place was well maintained, had plenty of useful amenities, and is situated in a beautiful location with scenic views.

name: Rachael
review: Debras home was beautiful but was cold and appropriate sleeping arrangements were not met when requested. Her communication skills were sub-par, when we tried to find resolutions we were met with slow or no response. Furthermore, It felt like we were being monitored rather than hosted which led to the whole experience being a little disappointing.

name: Janine
review: We loved our stay in Kelowna! Mike was very accommodating with our later-than-expected arrival and ensured we had everything we needed for the evening. The view of the Okanagan Valley was amazing, especially in the pool and hot tub (and water slide). It was very clean and spacious! We would recommend people to consider staying here!

name: Mehran
review: We had a wonderful one-night stay! The place was very clean, cozy, and well-prepared for guests. Everything we needed was available, and the atmosphere was peaceful and relaxing. Debra, the host, was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful—she truly made us feel at home. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay. Thank you, Debra!

name: Kayla
review: Beautiful location!! Host wasnt as personable as one would hope for given this is an industry where I feel like maybe just a little bit of a warmer demeanor would go a long way. For what you pay the amenities are on par, place was clean and location was stunning. Over all the stay was great!

name: Fiona
review: Had an amazing stay and felt right at home. The space was much larger than expected and had everything we needed.

name: Cait
review: Great spot to stay. The backyard is breathtaking, amazing views! Very spacious inside as well. Felt very private despite having the owner upstairs. Would definitely stay again.

name: George
review: There are 4 of us in the group (2 couples) all above 50 that stayed for 1 night. Our experience did not match the reviews that I had read before booking. As the weather was bad, we did not use the pool or sat long outdoors. That turned our focus indoors and that was where we did not get a good impression. We were planning to do some cooking but did not as the stove and oven were dirty. The crockery and utensils were somewhat grimy. The bathroom had half used soap left over and there was dust and grime on the edges and walls. The stairs leading down to the basement where we stayed are quite steep and may pose some difficulties for seniors. Like a previous guest, we had assumed we were booking an entire home but that turned out not to be the case. However, I understand that it was advertised that way because of Airbnb's policy. On the whole, we did not have a comfortable stay, but in all fairness, it may be because as older people, we have different needs and expectations. The overall impression is that not much was provided by way of hospitality because of the pool, hot tub and other outdoors amenities that are there, as a sort of a trade-off. I suppose for those looking for fun and excitement, the place would probably be great, but I can’t recommend it to older people looking for a clean & comfortable place. Perhaps the problem is not with the host but the entire Airbnb experience. We left feeling that we would have been better off had we continued our stay at a motel in Kelowna that we had stayed just a day before.

name: Gabriel
review: We stayed 2 nights here. Our kids loved the pool and slide that we can use. We also enjoyed the beautiful scenery in the backyard. Debra was quick to respond to any questions we had.

name: Ben
review: Entering the place day one was exactly how the photos were. The place was super clean and of course super fun to experience having your own pool and other amenities. Great for families.

name: Brett
review: A great experience all around. Super easy check-in (which is much appreciated). The pool deck and hot tub are fantastic. Debra made everything easy and she was super accommodating.

name: Priyanka
review: The house was very well kept, rooms were neat. Location of house was nice too! Had a very nice view. Kitchen had basic items stocked as well (salt,pepper etc..) The bathroom had a few issues, for instance the shower curtain rod wasn’t secured onto the wall properly and fell multiple times while in the shower. The shower/tub itself did not have a bath mat so it was very easy to fall in there. Neighbours were all very polite & nice! No issues with them at all in terms of us being too loud. Quiet time at 10pm is VERY strict so if you’re a bigger group trying to chill/hang out in the house after 10pm expect a complaint from host/hosts husband. Host contacted me at 9pm the night before to finalize details which I thought was unprofessional & her replies aren’t as quick as one would like.

name: Rayvin
review:
All in all we had a good stay. The view was literally breathtaking from the pool side and Debra was very accommodating to any requests or enquiries I had. 
I will say, she is strict on the rules. If you can’t stay quiet past 10pm she will let you know. If you don’t stay out the pool past 10pm she will let you know. We did get a few warnings but adjusted. If you can stay quiet this won’t be an issue.

name: T
review: If you want an awesome view of Okanagan lake, a pool, a hot tub, a sauna and a lovely living space... this is the place. This is my third AirBnB in Kelowna area and it is my favourite so far. Instructions were clear, the place was well appointed and you can enjoy a lovely glass of Okanagan wine overlooking a pool and a spectacular view. Definitely recommended.

name: Gary
review: Amazing place. Pool was perfect. Everything as described.

name: Meghan
review: This place is amazing! The pool, hot tub, outdoor area and view was just perfect. The place was very spacious, and had everything we could have ever needed! Being so close to so many wineries was a huge bonus as well!

name: Kayla
review: Great place! Slept 8 people comfortably and was great to be able to use the hot tub and BBQ. Close to town and host was easy to communicate with!

name: Nicole
review: Easy check in and out. Place was great for three of us and room for more. We didn't spend too much time at the airbnb other than sleeping but we did use the hot tub at night. Enjoyed our stay, thank you.

name: Tracy
review: We truly enjoyed our stay. The suite was beautiful, spotless and conveniently located. The deck, pool area and views were amazing. Debra was a very pleasant and responsive host. Would definitely recommend.

name: Rebecca
review: Loved the pool and hot tub! I was nervous about the hosts living right above but we had no issues. Sad we only got to stay 2 nights but all 6 of us agreed we would want to stay again if we’re in the area!

name: Amanda
review: Debra’s place was beautiful, clean and exactly like the photos on Airbnb. However do not make the same mistake as I did and not reading the “additional” rules. We tried to have my son’s cousin over for a visit and we were met with several texts (fair, I didn’t read all the rules) and they were forced to leave but not without several glares from Debra and her husband. Our stay was not relaxing, as I received more texts from the landlord, one even asking for us to not close the door so hard ( we are a family, not a bachelor party). We felt constantly watched, we even looked for cameras at one point cause we couldn’t shake the feeling. I wanted so badly to just fully enjoy myself here but sadly we could not.

name: Randy
review: It was a perfect place great view, very quiet. We found cooking on hot plate to be a little difficult with more than 2 people.

name: Emily
review: Our group of 7 loved utilizing the completely private outdoor space (pool, BBQ, hot tub). We were also pleasantly surprised by the spacious/fully equipped kitchen. Could not have asked for a better place to relax/continue the fun after long lake days!

name: Leanna
review: We came for a girls trip to Kelowna for the weekend and had a wonderful stay at Debra's. They were very welcoming and organized and the place was great with a beautiful view and yard! The pool and water slide was awesome. Would definitely recommend!

name: Paul
review: We were a group of 6 travelling on a business tour, and fell in love with the photos of the place. The view was beautiful! Debra greeted us when we arrived & gave us a tour of the property, showing us how the hot tub, pool, slide, sauna all turn on. There was a quick and easy communication throughout our stay in case we ever needed anything, and the house itself was very well taken care of. Would highly recommend!

name: Matthew
review: This house is amazing and offers everything. Super big space and hosts are super chill and great to stay with. No compliments, I will definitely be back!

name: Kim
review: Debra’s place exceeded all of our expectations. Her suite is very clean and there was plenty of space for all of us. The hot tub and sauna were a great bonus and the views were exceptional! Highly recommended!

name: Andrea
review: 6 of us ladies had a wonderful stay. Beautiful views from the pool. Was perfect for our stay. The Host was very responsive and easy to communicate with.

name: Emily
review: Beautiful view, great pool and hot tub! Beds were comfortable, place was clean. Highly recommend and would come again!

name: Monica
review: Debra was a great host, she communicated with us throughout our stay and made our stay easy. Her place was really nice and we enjoyed using the pool and hot tub. We would definitely come back and stay with Debra again.

name: Leanne
review: Beautiful suite accommodation with everything you need and more. Extremely clean, spacious and a beautiful view. The hosts were very accommodating and easy to communicate with. Would definitely book again.

name: Kelly
review: The space was big and comfortable. The location is close to everything you need and not far from Downtown Kelowna at all. The pool was amazing and I really wish I could wake up to that view every day. The space could use a bit of an update but that’s not really a big deal. Debra was very nice, took a bit longer to get a response one of the days but overall quite responsive. Would recommend for sure.

name: Sarah
review: Debra's place met all of our expectations. Hosts were super friendly upon arrival, yet the area was so private, we didn't even know they were there. The patio was where we spent the most time, fully equipped with pool, jacuzzi, BBQ, and a large sitting area. The suite was super clean and we found everything we needed, including toiletries, towels, and kitchen supplies. Definitely a must stay!

name: Dollard
review: Place was great over all, bigger than expected. Amazing view from the hot tub, hot tub was under cover. Couldn’t ask for a better place than this one.

name: Kavin
review: Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Deb was a responsive and thoughtful host who made everything easy. It felt like a home away from home – highly recommended! Would definitely stay again.

name: Francesco
review: The accommodation was very nice with everything one would need from a VRBO. Communicating with Debra was easy and efficient. Would gladly stay again.

name: Greg
review:
We enjoyed our brief stay at Debra’s place. It was unseasonably cold (-11°F / -24°C!) but between the heaters, sauna and hot tub, we stayed toasty and warm!
The views are terrific, the beds were comfy, and we managed a simple meal in the kitchen (if you’re an induction burner newbie like us, make sure to use a steel pan).
The pool looks really nice if you’re visiting in the warmer months.

name: Jaime
review: This was the perfect space for our girls weekend. Plenty of room, beautiful view, and the pool was such a treat to have. We can’t wait to visit again!

name: Lisa
review: Our stay was absolutely fabulous. Check in with Debra was quick and thorough. The unit was especially clean and spacious which was really great. The kitchen was very large and had everything we needed. We loved the pool and hot tub where we spent most of our time getting some much needed R&R. This was an awesome place to stay! Thanks again Debra and Mike!!

name: Caroline
review:
We came to Kelowna for a gymnastics competition.  Debra was incredibly kind and flexible with changing dates which was very appreciated.  
The location of the home was incredible.  The views were amazing! 
The space was incredibly spacious, clean and had everything we needed.   It was nice and quiet and the beds were very comfortable.  The pool and hot tub were a wonderful amenity that we enjoyed. 
Debra was very helpful and made sure everything was perfect.   
We would love to stay there again in the future if we have another competition! 
Highly recommend!

name: Michelle
review: Our stay with Debra was absolutely amazing. She was so accommodating and caring. She gave us our privacy but also cared for us we needed it. Recommend this place to anyone. The amenities are amazing and should rightly be respected.

name: Leanne
review: Beautiful view of lake and mountains. Pool, hot tub and sauna was clean and fun. The suite was much larger than I expected and very well equipped. Debra was available to help us wen we needed her. Kids loved the slide! We will return next time we visit Kelowna!

name: Vyness
review: Wonderful place to stay!! The beds were so comfy and the place was clean. Debra came and met us personally which was really sweet she made sure we were okay during our stay!

name: Aidan
review: Debra’s place is the perfect place if you are looking for something quiet and beautiful. The pool and hot tub are awesome and the location is great. Debra was very responsive and even met us at check in to show us around. All in all, we had an amazing stay and would definitely come back. Thanks so much Debra.

name: Kyle
review: We stayed three nights and loved the pool, slide and view. The accommodations met our needs and reflect the reviews we read ahead of time. The host was very friendly and helpful.

name: Meghan
review: The house was amazing and well kept. The pool and hot tub was very clean as well as the beds and bedrooms. Loved that it fit 8 of us. We stayed for a stagette and it worked out amazing Beautiful view of the lake. As well close enough to town if you would like to venture.

name: Jocelyn Marie
review:
Our little family of four had a fantastic stay! The place was just as the pictures show and the view was even better. Nice and clean and had all the essentials a person would need - which was awesome! Such a beautiful poolside to relax by and close to all kinds of amenities. 
Good communication and it was easy for us to check in and out. We had the privacy we needed and the help when we needed it.
Will return!

name: James
review: It's so nice view and so fun pool. This house is pretty clean and nice room and kitchen. I strongly recommand this house.

name: Mel
review: Great pool and beautiful view!  Very clean and spacious.  Comfortable beds.  Great hosts!

name: Joanna
review:
Beautiful views, spacious, clean, comfy, and the hot tub and infra red sauna were amazing after skiing!! 
Communication was prompt, but a few issues we identified weren't addressed (like dirty dishes), which felt incongruous with the expectations on us (e.g  empty the dishwasher before we left).

name: Jing
review: We are two family travel together to Jasper. pay almost 650 CAD for this basement. One bathroom, mean bedroom has no door no privacy. gas grill is not clean. It’s not worth what we pay for. View is okay. You can see part of winery and part of lake. AND landlord ask us to pay other 70 CAD for cleaning fee again. Because I quote “The house is to be left as found. Clearly this is not the case here”.

name: Kara
review: Debra was very welcoming on check-in. The hot tub and sauna were really nice at the end of the day. Great view and only a 10 minute drive to downtown. It was great for what we needed.

name: Tejanna
review: Beautiful place to stay, super clean and spacious! Pool, slide, hottub, sauna, gorgeous view! The bed were so comfy! Would definitely stay here again!

name: Thisari
review: Debra was a wonderful host! Check in was a breeze and she communicated with us proactively throughout. The house was very clean and just like the description. Hot tub was definitely the highlight and had a great view of the hills around.

name: Kai
review: Enjoyed our stay very much. The place is much larger than I expected and was also very clean, which was appreciated. The bed was very comfortable and the hottub and sauna were nice in the cool early spring weather.

name: Jaskirat
review: We had a great stay at this Airbnb in West Kelowna. The place was exactly as described -clean, well-maintained, and thoughtfully set up for guests. The check-in process was smooth and communication with the host was prompt and clear throughout our stay.

name: Parham
review: Host was super cooperative with us even though we were mislead into this home with false advertisement stating that its the entire home? We later found out that it was the basement sweet of the home which wasn't the a huge deal breaker since we were already there. Even though we were super careful throughout the trip I wouldn't stay here ever again.  Host was way to over protective about everything. Wouldn't let the music level go higher than half way on our tiny Bose speaker in the middle of the afternoon. This sums up our experience with Debra. Her husband was the best! Super cool with everything.

name: David
review: Really lovely place to stay for the night. Very clean and spacious. All amenities excellent. Only minor issue would be to extend the curfew on a weekday during the summer months to 11.

name: Diane
review: Lovely clean spacious rental.  Fit all our needs. Was wonderful having a hot tub after a rainy day out.

name: Haiyi
review: Its close enough to the mission hill and quail's gate winery estate. I like the swimming pool since it is hot in july. Everything is good so far except the noise that from air conditioner or some machines is pretty annoying.

name: Baptiste
review: Very nice and spacious apartment! Debra is very welcoming and she really tried to make our stay the most comfortable to have fun. We really enjoyed the swimming-pool, the hot-tub and the beautiful view. We will come back :-)

name: Nick
review: Great location! View from the pool is beautiful. Debra was quite accommodating and made our stay enjoyable. Would stay again.

name: Natassia
review:
Debra's place perfect for our weekend getaway.  There was 6 of us total and 2 toddlers.  The place was spacious and the pool/deck/hot tub were icing on the cake.
 Debra was friendly and always willing to help when we needed something.

name: Amanda
review: Comfortable with nice views and pool. A bit noisy from the road below, busy area.

name: Kristina
review: Nice place, the host lives upstairs but we had the backyard (pool and hot tub) to ourselves during our visit. We were very happy with this accommodation.

name: Ray
review: great place to relax with the family, would definitely stay here again. Pool and hot tub were real clean.

name: Tara
review: We had a great stay, it was exactly as described. The location and suite were stunning! We would stay again.

name: Britteny
review: Debra was really responsive and informative on the space. It was really comfortable and the hot tub was an excellent perk! She was flexible when we wanted to extend our stay. Would recommend her place!

name: Laura
review: Beautiful stay, loved the winter evening in the hot tub with a great view.  the beds were really comfortable and the neighbourhood was nice and quiet.

name: Rebecca
review:
Thank you Debra and to your husband for the warm welcome . You guys are amazing, keep it up . 
The place was great and it’s beyond our expectations. We love our experience and stay . The sauna and the hot tub was a plus. 
The place was really big , it can accommodate for 2 family of 4 .

name: Aida
review:
We noticed the pool was too cold our entire stay and that was disappointing since that was one of the main reasons we chose the bnb.
Otherwise it was comfortable and we enjoyed our stay.

name: Jenna
